goal.en: Find the rice and the soy sauce, and check for a sale.
goal.zh: 找到米和醬油，順便問問有沒有特價。

background: large bright supermarket aisle with long shelves of plain colorful cans and boxes, an empty shopping cart, polished floor, fluorescent ceiling lights, weekend morning

intro.en: Saturday morning. Mia drags you to FreshMart for your first big grocery run.
intro.zh: 星期六早上，米亞拉著你去 FreshMart，展開你的第一次大採購。

intro.en: I'll get the snacks. You find the rice and soy sauce. Meet you at the checkout!
intro.zh: 我去拿零食，你負責找米和醬油。結帳區見！

intro.en: The store is huge. A staff member is stacking cans nearby.
intro.zh: 超市大得驚人。旁邊有位店員正在堆罐頭。

lines.en: Hi there! Need a hand with anything?

choices.en: Yes. Where can I find the rice?
choices.tip: Where can I find + 商品？是在店裡問東西放哪裡最好用的句型。

choices.en: Yes. Where I can find the rice?
choices.zh: 需要，哪裡我可以找到米？

lines.en: Oh, you know where it is? Great, you're all set then!
lines.zh: 喔，你知道在哪裡？太好了，那你沒問題了！

story.en: He gives you a thumbs-up and walks away. You spend twenty minutes in the pet food aisle before you finally find the rice.
story.zh: 他對你比個讚就走了。你在寵物食品區轉了二十分鐘，才終於找到米。

fail.why: 問句要把助動詞 can 放到主詞 I 前面：Where can I find...?。Where I can find... 是陳述句的語序，聽起來像話只說了一半。

choices.en: No, thanks. I have two hands.

story.en: He chuckles and goes back to his cans. Your two hands carry an empty basket around the store three times before you find the rice.
story.zh: 他笑了笑，回去繼續堆罐頭。你的兩隻手提著空籃子繞了超市三圈，才找到米。

fail.why: Need a hand? 是「需要幫忙嗎？」的慣用說法，不是在問你有幾隻手。需要幫忙就說 Yes. Where can I find...?。

lines.en: Rice is in aisle seven, next to the noodles. Follow me!
lines.zh: 米在第七走道，就在麵的旁邊。跟我來！

lines.en: There are two bags of rice. One has a bright yellow price tag.
lines.zh: 架上有兩種米，其中一種的價格牌是亮黃色的。
就是這裡。還需要什麼嗎？

choices.en: Thanks! Is this one on sale?
choices.tip: Is this on sale? 是問特價最直接的說法，on sale 就是「正在特價」。

lines.en: Has discount? Oh, do you mean our member card?
lines.zh: 有折扣？喔，你是說我們的會員卡嗎？

story.en: Ten minutes later, you own a shiny FreshMart member card. You still have no idea what the rice costs.
story.zh: 十分鐘後，你多了一張亮晶晶的 FreshMart 會員卡，卻還是不知道米多少錢。

fail.why: 「這個有打折嗎？」不能直譯成 This one has discount?。問特價要說 Is this on sale?，也可以問 Is there a discount on this?。

choices.en: Thanks! Can you make it cheaper?
choices.zh: 謝謝！可以算我便宜一點嗎？

lines.en: Cheaper? Sorry, I can't change the prices here.
lines.zh: 便宜一點？抱歉，這裡的價格我不能改。

story.en: He looks very uncomfortable and suddenly remembers some cans that need stacking. You never find out the rice was on sale.
story.zh: 店員一臉為難，突然想起還有罐頭要堆。你始終不知道那袋米其實正在特價。

fail.why: 超市、連鎖店都是不二價，跟店員殺價會讓對方很尷尬。想知道有沒有優惠，問 Is this on sale? 就好。

lines.en: Yes, it's ten percent off this week. Anything else?
lines.zh: 有，這週打九折。還需要什麼嗎？

choices.en: Which aisle is the soy sauce in?
choices.tip: Which aisle is... in? 把介系詞 in 放在句尾，是英文問位置的自然語序。

choices.en: Which aisle have the soy sauce?

lines.en: Which aisle... have? Sorry, can you say that again?
lines.zh: 哪個走道……有？抱歉，可以再說一次嗎？

story.en: Too shy to repeat it, you grab the first dark bottle you see. At home, Mia tastes it. It's vinegar.
story.zh: 你不好意思再問一次，隨手抓了第一瓶深色的瓶子。回家後米亞嚐了一口：是醋。

fail.why: aisle 是單數，動詞要用 has。更自然的問法是 Which aisle is the soy sauce in? 或 Where can I find the soy sauce?。

choices.en: Just tell me where the soy sauce is.
choices.zh: 直接告訴我醬油在哪就好。

lines.en: Okay... aisle three. Have a nice day.
lines.zh: 好喔……第三走道。祝你有美好的一天。

story.en: He answers in four words and walks off. A minute later, he gives the next customer a big smile and a free coupon.
story.zh: 他用幾個字打發你就走了。一分鐘後，他笑容滿面地招呼下一位客人，還送了一張折價券。

fail.why: Just tell me... 聽起來很不耐煩，像在命令對方。客氣地問 Which aisle is the soy sauce in?，或用 Could you tell me...? 開頭。

lines.en: Aisle three, top shelf. Have a good one!
lines.zh: 第三走道，最上層。祝你有美好的一天！

lines.en: Kai! Rice on sale and soy sauce? You're already a shopping pro!
lines.zh: 凱！特價的米加醬油？你已經是採買高手了！

story.en: You meet Mia at the checkout with everything on the list. Her basket, of course, is full of cookies.
story.zh: 你帶著清單上的東西在結帳區和米亞會合。她的籃子裡，果然裝滿了餅乾。

notes.explain: 在超市、商店問東西放哪裡最好用的句型。問句語序是 Where can I...，不是 Where I can...。

example.en: Excuse me, where can I find the milk?
example.zh: 不好意思，請問牛奶在哪裡？

notes.explain: 超市貨架之間的通道叫 aisle，發音和 I'll 一樣，s 不發音。問位置可以說 Which aisle is it in?。

example.en: The snacks are in aisle five.

notes.explain: on sale 是「正在特價」。英文說 ten percent off（減一成），中文說「打九折」，數字剛好相反，別算錯。

example.en: Is this on sale? Yes, it's twenty percent off.
example.zh: 這個有特價嗎？有，打八折。

notes.explain: a hand 在這裡是「幫忙」，不是真的手。需要就說 Yes, please.，不需要就說 I'm good, thanks.。

example.en: Need a hand with those bags? Yes, please!
example.zh: 要幫你拿那些袋子嗎？好，麻煩你！

notes.explain: 超市與連鎖店的價格是固定的，不能跟店員殺價。想省錢就留意特價，或問 Are there any deals today?。

example.en: Are there any deals on fruit today?
example.zh: 今天水果有什麼優惠嗎？
